meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先用三个工具给代码建“地图”：按关键词搜出相关文件和函数结构，再只看你关心的那个函数或类的完整代码，而不是整篇读文件。
howto.when: 当你想找某个函数、理解代码结构或高效浏览代码库时触发；它会先搜索建立结构，再按需展开细节。

say.text: 帮我在 src 里搜索 shutdown 相关代码，列出位置和结构
say.note: 会调用 smart_search 返回符号和文件概览

howto.what_en: After this skill is active, Claude builds a structural map of the code first (search/outline), then unfolds only the symbols you need—instead of reading whole files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to locate a function, understand code structure, or explore a codebase efficiently; Claude searches for structure first and fetches details on demand.

say_en.text: Search src for shutdown-related code and list locations
say_en.note: Runs smart_search to return symbols and file overviews

say_en.text: Show me the functions and classes in services/worker-service.ts
say_en.note: Runs smart_outline to produce a file skeleton

say_en.text: Show the full implementation of performGracefulShutdown in GracefulShutdown.ts
say_en.note: Runs smart_unfold to fetch only that symbol's source
